content: Chrome extension auth (developer.chrome.com + community, fetched 2026-11-27): externally_connectable.matches lets own web origin message the extension (keep narrow); chrome.identity.launchWebAuthFlow + PKCE with redirect https://<id>.chromiumapp.org works but runs in an isolated partition (no shared cookies, re-login friction reported); tokens: access in chrome.storage.session, refresh in chrome.storage.local; chrome.alarms minimum period 30s since Chrome 120 (polling for badge).
